comparison.objective: Stows a knife with its blade safely oriented away; candidate fractures and collects insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe grasping and orientation of a hazardous tool differ from mandrel stabilization, hammer impact regulation, coil protection, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Safe knife stowage is title-supported with no detailed rubric/spec. Candidate requires four physical fractures, complete tang containment, and no shell or insert damage.
comparison.reason: The tested manipulation and safety failure modes are different.
